seats.name: Keep
seats.flavor: Grey stone, narrow windows, no surrender.
seats.con: Grim halls: everyone's Sanity is 5% lower.

seats.name: Chateau
seats.flavor: Gilded halls built on older, darker cellars.
seats.con: The cellars stir: troubles at home a quarter more often.

seats.name: Manor
seats.flavor: Ivy, hounds and a long table.
seats.pro: One more recruit at the start.

seats.name: Abbey
seats.flavor: Bells at every hour, and something under the crypt.
seats.con: Tithes to the altar: Gold income -10%.

seats.name: Spire
seats.flavor: A tower that hums when the stars align.
seats.con: Scholars, not soldiers: everyone's HP is 5% lower.

seats.name: Catacomb Hall
seats.flavor: The house above is modest. The house below is not.
seats.con: The house below is restless: troubles at home a quarter more often.

seats.name: Longhall
seats.flavor: Smoke, mead, oaths sworn on old iron.

seats.name: Harbor House
seats.con: Damp stores: 5% of the House's stores spoil each Year.
